description: Docs that mention eval() and unsafe must not outrank a real innerHTML injection.

files.base:
# Security

Never call eval(userInput). In Rust avoid unsafe blocks and .unwrap() on user data.
files.head:
# Security

Never call eval(userInput) or new Function(userInput). In Rust avoid unsafe blocks and .unwrap() on user data.
Shell commands built with child_process.exec(`${name}`) are injection risks.
